atAGlance: Cơm chiên dương châu is Dương Châu fried rice, usually with egg, sausage or ham, shrimp, peas, carrot, and scallion.
whatItIs: Cơm chiên dương châu is Yangzhou-style fried rice in Vietnamese restaurant language, usually with egg, sausage or ham, shrimp, peas, carrots, and scallions.
howToEnjoy: Eat it hot while the grains stay separate and lightly smoky from the wok. Add chili or soy-lime seasoning sparingly so the egg and sausage flavor stays clear.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm chiên dương châu when you want a mixed fried rice plate. Ask for no shrimp, no pork sausage, or less oil before the wok starts if those matter.
worthKnowing: This is a familiar Chinese-Vietnamese restaurant order, useful when traveling with people who want something simple but still local to the menu style.
goodToKnow: This mixed fried rice can include shrimp and pork sausage or ham, so ask first if shellfish or pork matters.
